text.what: Picking into small crates by hand, so the bunch arrives whole and the cellar decides what to do with it. A machine strips berries off the stem in the row, which settles the whole-cluster question before anyone gets a vote.
text.how: Whole-cluster work, sorting tables and cold soaks all assume intact fruit. Steep slopes settle it anyway: no machine drives the Côte d'Or's mid-slope.

kin.as: Where the slope makes the choice for you.
